rows.title: Lamont’s fiscal success rests on foundation laid by Malloy, others
rows.standfirst: Former Gov. Dannel P. Malloy and legislators who served with him ordered tax hikes that generated billions for CT during Ned Lamont’s tenure.

rows.title: As prediction markets grow, CT comptroller warns of ‘dark side’
rows.standfirst: Sean Scanlon’s report found the platforms have led to gambling addiction and insider trading, and have been marketed to people under 21.

rows.title: Lamont sticks to a fiscal discipline not always applauded by labor
rows.standfirst: Unions support Gov. Ned Lamont, even if they remain unenthused about his hostility to committing to new things that have a recurring cost.

rows.title: Many immigrants with legal status could lose Medicare coverage
rows.standfirst: Hundreds of lawfully present immigrants in CT could lose Medicare health coverage in January, and officials must decide whether to help.

rows.title: Report: SNAP benefits vanishing faster than CT officials expected
rows.standfirst: Nearly 63,000 people in CT have lost federal nutrition benefits since last July — roughly double officials’ projections, a new report says.

rows.title: Union benefits package looms large over CT campaigns
rows.standfirst: The contract guaranteeing pensions and other benefits to CT state employees expires June 30, but few candidates are discussing its renewal.
